objective.statement: Learn four gentle words, and two words that say how much: delicato, leggiero, tranquillo, semplice, ben and tanto.
successCriteria: I know delicato is delicate and leggiero is light and nimble.
I know tranquillo means calm and semplice means simple and plain.
I know ben means well and tanto means so much, as in ben marcato and non tanto.

explanation.text: The first four words ask for gentle playing. Delicato is delicate, leggiero is light and nimble, tranquillo is calm and semplice is simple and plain. Ben and tanto are small words that join with another word.
“delicato” means delicate. “leggiero” means light and nimble. “tranquillo” means calm. “semplice” means simple and plain.
Ben means well, so ben marcato means well marked: clearly emphasised. Tanto means so much, so non tanto means not so much.

music.textAlternative: A two-bar melody in G major marked non tanto.

explanation.caption: Non tanto: not so much. It softens the word it belongs with.
